evidence.note: a1 (Environment Augmented Generation) couples LLM reasoning to real-time execution feedback (Python code blocks validated by a sandbox at each step) plus dynamic branch exploration guided by an information-gain-weighted branch value function, trained via SFT on a curated 2,000-trajectory dataset (EAG-2K) built from error-correction and branching examples -- producing a distinctive 'steep scaling' pattern where a1-32B initially trails a same-size non-interactive baseline at low token budgets (due to feedback-cycle overhead) but decisively overtakes it past a 4-8K-token inflection point, ultimately matching o1 on AIME24 (74.4%) with far fewer parameters and training examples.
evidence.title: a1: Steep Test-time Scaling Law via Environment Augmented Generation
